query:
The group has a norm of a monthly minimum check-in in the chat. Does everyone follow it?

Options:
A. Abi
B. Dev
C. Kwame
D. Sasha
context:
[1] (about=Kwame, episodic, t6 @2025-06-23T21:14:00) Also, quick admin. Dev, you've been MIA for like six weeks. The whole point of this chat is monthly minimum. I know you're in the archive. Send a voice note, a meme, anything.
[2] (about=Dev, episodic, t6 @2025-06-23T23:58:00) sorry, I know, I know. head down in the archive. I'm trying to come for the Saturday. I genuinely want to be there. when the PhD is done this all gets easier, I promise 💙
[3] (about=Dev, episodic, t2 @2025-06-09T23:22:00) sorry, only just seeing this, head down in the archive. November I genuinely want to come. When the PhD is done things will be different. I promise I'll try to make November work
[4] (about=Dev, episodic, t0 @2025-06-02T16:17:00) sorry, head down in the archive all morning 🙈 Amsterdam sounds incredible and I genuinely want to come. October is tricky but I don't want to say no yet. can we talk dates?
[5] (about=Kwame, episodic, t8 @2025-06-30T14:59:00) yes. Sasha's format from now on. Dev, you missed a good one. I'll tell you about it when we speak. You were there in spirit.
[6] (about=Abi, episodic, t6 @2025-06-24T00:02:00) yes literally a blurry archive corridor pic would sustain us for a month 😂
[7] (about=Sasha, episodic, t6 @2025-06-24T00:01:00) no guilt spiral pls, just send us something chaotic once in a while and we're happy 😊
[8] (about=Abi, episodic, t6 @2025-06-23T21:12:00) Kwame's cooking!! Yes perfect 🥰 Dev, can you make it? We miss you!
[9] (about=Kwame, episodic, t4 @2025-06-16T18:37:00) First Saturday of next month. I'll be at mine. Dev, I'm coming to Edinburgh next week actually. Separate thing. He's heads-down at the moment but I wanted to see him.
[10] (about=Kwame, episodic, t2 @2025-06-09T20:04:00) I can host in London. Sasha's idea is the right one. We've been trying to book hotels and trips for two years. Let's just be in the same room. Dev, you have to actually come.
agent_answer:
No — not everyone follows it.

- **Abi**: follows the norm (active in the chat, e.g., enthusiastically coordinating calls).
- **Dev**: does **not** follow it — Kwame calls him out for being MIA for about six weeks, and Dev repeatedly apologizes for only just seeing messages.
- **Kwame**: follows it (he enforces/pins the monthly check-in, reminds Dev).
- **Sasha**: follows it (active; their format is even adopted as the standard).
